Case note: Com. S. No. 1296/2021
Client: Neha Malhotra (retired bank officer, Kochi)
Opposing party: Indus Motors Ltd
Court: Kochi Commercial Court
Filed on: 4 January 2021
Claim amount: Rs. 12,89,00,000
Issue: breach of contract. The counterparty terminated the contract without notice.
Advice given: Send a notice of breach giving the cure period required by the contract.
Outcome: The termination was held to be wrongful.
Recommended next step: Claim loss of profit for the remaining term.
Witness: Sunanda Patil
Matter code: Project Flamingo
